tips: Prioritize Reels as the primary content format, as they perform dramatically better (avg score 225) compared to static picture posts (28) and text breaking news (22).
Publish more content in Urdu ('ur'), which outperforms English ('en') content with nearly double the average engagement score (0.61 vs 0.31).
Focus coverage on High-performing topics like Science/Tech (1.85 score) and Business (1.53 score), alongside high-interest Pakistan news.
Schedule posts strictly between 14:00 UTC and 20:00 UTC to capture peak audience activity, avoiding late night/early morning slots (02:00-09:00 UTC).
Avoid posting low-engagement image posts ('pic') on general world/asia/africa topics, and refrain from duplicating identical breaking news posts.
